category_title: Students with high online continuity and regular LMS engagement
minimal_context: The student is writing a post about their weekend plans on the online discussion board and replying to peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please post a few lines describing your plans for the weekend on the discussion board, and then respond to two of your peers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay, I posted my sentences: 'I will go to the park this weekend. I will play soccer.'

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you write a bit more about that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know many words yet. I will just add: 'I like the park. It is good.'

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please make sure to reply to your classmates' posts now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I replied to John. I just wrote 'Me too, I have the same plans.' I don't know how to say anything else to start a real discussion.

task.content: post a few lines describing their favorite type of music or their plans for the weekend and then to respond to two or three of their peers’ postings by simply indicating whether they shared the same preferences or plans
task.learning_goal: use of the target language for display purposes

context.environment: online discussion boards as part of their regular assignments
context.materials: ebook and other online materials included with the textbook (reading and listening to authentic cultural content, games, quizzes, etc.)
context.social_setting: communicated via the LMS with the instructor and peers
context.time_context: During the online portion of the course

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: because they were lower-level language students with limited linguistic resources
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: use of the target language for display purposes rather than to generate rich discussions

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: only provided a very limited picture of a student’s engagement and interaction with the course
